title: A Lone Wolf Blazes Its Own Trail

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On my way back from an errand in a neighboring
town,
I spotted another branch of our usual pool
hall.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thinking I might get some practice in,
I stepped inside—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: You guys turn up everywhere, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Pierced Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, why not?
Wherever Sirius-senpai goes, we follow!

text_block_list.name: Undercut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Totally. I mean, what are we without you,
Senpai?
Just let it slide! Haha.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking around,
there are plenty of familiar Umamusume
here. For a moment,
I almost thought I'd walked into our regular
joint.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: You... come with me.

text_block_list.name: Undercut Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Huh? Me? Y... Yes?!

text_block_list.name: Shaved-Head Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... Sirius-senpai?
What's the matter...?
Did I do something wrong...?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Standing in front of me with that pathetic
fake smile plastered on your face.
...It pisses me off.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I panicked,
thinking a fight was about to break out,
but just as I went to step in,
a dry chuckle cut through the air.

text_block_list.name: Shaved-Head Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
A-Ah... ahaha... Right. Of course.
Nothing gets past you, does it,
Sirius-senpai...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She followed her trainer's instructions,
but the results never came.
She'd been running with doubts eating away
at her—or so she confessed.

text_block_list.name: Shaved-Head Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
I thought about speaking up, but...
my friends and parents told me I should just
do what I'm told, you know?

text_block_list.name: Shaved-Head Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
I'm just really bad at dealing with awkward
tension, I guess... Ahahaha...
Sorry, pretty pathetic, huh...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I told you. It pisses me off.
Wipe that grin off your face when you're in
front of me.

text_block_list.name: Shaved-Head Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: Ngh...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Just because people tell you to,
you're gonna ignore what your own heart
wants?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Do what you're told? For what?
Are they gonna run the race for you? Hell no,
they won't.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
The one running—is you.
Nobody else can run your path for you.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
What do you get by letting others pull your
strings? A pile of rotten scraps at best.
Listen up. When the bill comes due,
you're the one who pays it.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
If you're just gonna blame others for your
regrets, pick your own damn path.
Even if the thorns tear into you,
own up to your own choices.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Unless you'd rather choke on pointless
regrets.

text_block_list.name: Shaved-Head Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
B-But... it's scary...
What if...
what if everyone abandons me...? I just...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Why give a damn about people who'd drop you
that easily?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
They're just shackles holding you back.
Dead weight with zero use.
If they walk away on their own,
consider it a blessing.

text_block_list.name: Shaved-Head Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: Sirius-senpai...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Make a choice.
The will to choose always strips away what
you never needed in the first place.

text_block_list.name: Shaved-Head Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, haha... ahaha...!
You're right... Yeah,
you're totally right...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sirius Symboli's words are always so
blunt...
To be frank,
she can be downright merciless.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She isn't always right,
and it's hard to find gentleness in what
she says.
...And yet, strangely enough,

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I close my eyes and replay her words in my
mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Beneath that dangerous edge,
there is undeniable strength in what she
says.
A power that makes you want to believe,
makes you want to follow—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Hey.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I know you missed your master, but
stalking me all the way out here is a bit
much.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Should I praise you for finding me without
getting lost?
...Little pup.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I timidly look up,
explaining that I hadn't been following
her,
nor had I intended to eavesdrop.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: A bit late for that.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Besides,
it's her fault for being sloppy and failing
to hide it.
I don't give a damn who heard us.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Now that I think about it,
that girl didn't look like she was troubled
at all
from an outsider's perspective. And yet,
Sirius Symboli...
choice_data_list: How did you know something was wrong?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Anyone would notice with a sickening grin
like that.
Just having her in my sight was annoying
enough.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Anyone would... No,
Sirius Symboli was the only one who
noticed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Maybe it's that side of her that...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
So, if you weren't following me,
why are you here?
You usually stick around your side of
town.
choice_data_list: I just finished work, thought I'd ...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Playing fetch sounds a lot more fitting for
a pup like you, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...My admiration is short-lived.
She's teasing me again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Refusing to back down,
I try to put on a stern face...
only for her to narrow her eyes with an
amused smirk.
